risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge or surface showing a material label, or a test result (e.g., a spark test or chemical test) confirming aluminium content.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if made of steel or unknown metal, which is less valuable than aluminium.

risks.risk: The sheets may have hidden defects such as thin gauge, poor coating, or manufacturing flaws that affect longevity and performance.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge showing the thickness and coating quality, or a photo of the underside and cross-section.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower quality or with reduced durability, assuming worst-case material and construction.
